title: Four strokes, one at a time

blocks.intro: The four strokes of the engine are:
items: **Intake** (suck)
**Compression** (squeeze)
**Power** (bang)
**Exhaust** (blow)

blocks.caption: One stroke per tap. Watch which valve is open each time.
blocks.narration: Tap Start, then Next, to move through the strokes one by one.

items: Piston moves **down**
Intake valve **open**, exhaust valve closed
The falling piston leaves **low pressure** behind it
Outside air pushes **air and fuel** in to fill the space
Like pulling back the plunger on a syringe
Piston moves **up**
**Both valves closed**, so the mix is sealed in
The mix is squeezed into about **a tenth** of the space
Squeezed mix burns **hotter** and pushes **harder**
Spark plug fires **just before the top**
The mix burns in a flash and gets very hot
Gas pressure **shoots up** and shoves the piston **down** hard
The **only** stroke that makes power
Piston moves **up**
Exhaust valve **open**, intake valve closed
The piston pushes the **burnt gas** out the exhaust
Then intake starts again, over and over
Each stroke = **half** a crank turn
Four strokes = **2 full turns** of the crankshaft
So you get **1 power stroke every 2 turns**

lines: At 3,000 RPM: 3,000 ÷ 2 = 1,500 power strokes a minute
blocks.say: Four strokes times half a turn each is two turns. At three thousand R P M, that's fifteen hundred power strokes a minute, or twenty five bangs every second, in each cylinder.

blocks.title: Who pushes on the other three strokes?
blocks.text: A heavy **flywheel** keeps spinning between bangs, like a merry-go-round you shoved once. Its momentum carries the piston through the other three strokes.

blocks.question: Which stroke actually makes the power?
blocks.explain: Only the power stroke pushes the piston. The other three use up a little energy, which the flywheel supplies.

blocks.question: During compression, the valves are…
blocks.explain: Both valves are shut so the mix has nowhere to go but get squeezed.

blocks.question: How many crankshaft turns does one full 4-stroke cycle take?
blocks.explain: Four strokes, each half a turn: 2 turns.
